name: Shaman Enhancement
text: **Shaman Enhancement**: Certain half-orcs know rituals to enhance the strength and brutality of their allies. These halforcs gain a +2 racial bonus on Spellcraft checks. In addition, when such a half-orc acquires an animal companion, bonded mount, cohort, familiar, or spirit animal, that creature gains a +2 bonus to Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution, as selected by the half-orc. This racial trait replaces weapon familiarity and intimidating.
